name: Channel Draw/Cylindrical Cup 2-Stage Test (Benchmark 3)
description: A standardized simulation benchmark providing reference results for the channel draw / cylindrical cup two-stage forming test used to validate metal-forming simulations.
evaluation_method: RMSE (root-mean-square error) / error norm against reference experimental curves and profiles
general_score_metric: RMSE (e.g., of thickness, strain, force/displacement profiles)
reputation: Well-known within the metal-forming and finite-element simulation community as a canonical validation case for forming simulations.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on finite-element/materials simulation; small number of standardized test cases; results sensitive to implementation details (mesh, constitutive laws, friction), making direct comparisons nontrivial.
